name: Signature Holo

components.pose: She stands with the staff raised in one hand and her other arm sweeping out to the side as the water answers, her gown and hair lifted as if underwater, chin lifted, a calm, sovereign gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: Great arcs of tidal water rise and hang in the air around her, a ring of floating water spheres orbits the staff, glowing {{MAGIC}} ripples spread across the terrace and moonlit spray glitters everywhere.

notes: HOLO edition 'Tide Matriarch': the Signature scene re-authored with an ascended pose, upgraded signature weapon, crown, mantle, grander magic and a closer dragon. Holo shader/foil is applied in the client, not baked in.
